tools.name: token_risk
tools.description: Risk report for a BNB Chain (bsc) or Base token: honeypot and buy/sell/transfer tax simulation, owner privileges (mint, blacklist, pause, fee changes), upgradeable proxy, liquidity USD, LP burned/locked share, owner holdings, risk score 0-100 with flags. Use before buying or recommending a token.

tools.name: new_launches
tools.description: Newest tokens launched on BNB Chain (PancakeSwap V2) and Base (Uniswap V2), each scanned for honeypots, taxes, liquidity and owner powers a few minutes after its pool is created. Newest first.
